title: Divorce: Why does it happen?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do some marriages survive serious problems while others end over smaller repeated conflicts?
Is divorce generally too easy, too difficult, or appropriately regulated in modern society?
How should parents protect children from conflict during a divorce?
Can couples remain good friends after divorce, or is distance usually healthier?
What kind of support should be available to couples before they decide to end a marriage?
